competitor_signals.what_it_means: Shiftly's enterprise sales model (demo-driven custom pricing) and feature gaps vs. multi-platform/automation rivals are now the primary positioning comparison angle across dealer evaluations
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix posts to Facebook Marketplace with one click. Transparent pricing. No hidden fees. No demo required. Install now and post your first 5 vehicles free.

competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix focuses on what you do best: posting inventory. We don't overcomplicate dealer ops with acquisition modules. One tool, one job, done right. 100% compliant auto-fills, zero bans.

competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Facebook tightened enforcement. Ventrix built compliance into the DNA: rate-limited posts, sold-unit auto-removal, zero spammy patterns. One-click safe posting. That's why dealers trust us.
